note: The closed lists from specs/creative.md (pairings, motifs, hero kinds, hero layouts, signatures), for code that must check a direction choice (the Builder's design brief, APP-42). creative.md is the source; test/showcase-pack.test.ts fails when the two differ. Copied into the Builder by npm run sync:site-pack.

pairings.name: Heavy geometric
pairings.heading: Outfit
pairings.fits: bold, sports, gaming, consumer apps with a strong voice

motifs.name: Board
motifs.looks: rows and columns with thin rules, small status dots

motifs.name: Ledger
motifs.looks: ruled lines, tabular numerals, quiet columns

motifs.name: Blueprint
motifs.looks: fine dot or cross grid, thin technical lines

motifs.name: Paper
motifs.looks: warm off-white, soft shadows, ink-coloured text

motifs.name: Terminal
motifs.looks: mono labels, prompt-style marks, sharp corners

motifs.name: Soft mesh
motifs.looks: blurred gradient shapes from the accent

motifs.name: Bands
motifs.looks: diagonal or stepped colour bands between sections

motifs.name: Stack
motifs.looks: two or three cards overlapping at a slight offset or tilt, each with a status chip, like a feed of items
motifs.goodFor: products whose core is a list of items: picks, deals, listings, matches, tickets

heroKinds.name: frame
heroKinds.what: a browser or device window holding a picture of the product's main screen, built in HTML and CSS

heroKinds.name: fragment
heroKinds.what: a small piece of the product's interface composed in HTML and CSS, without a window around it

heroKinds.name: owner-art
heroKinds.what: an image the owner supplied, used as given

heroLayouts.name: centred
heroLayouts.what: one centred stack, headline, line and buttons, with the preview below

heroLayouts.name: split
heroLayouts.what: on desktop, the text on the left and the fragment on the right; on a phone it stacks, the fragment below the main button

signatures.name: headline-marker
signatures.what: a recurring marker under key words in headlines

signatures.name: section-index
signatures.what: section index labels (01, 02, 03) in the accent font

signatures.name: status-chips
signatures.what: status chips used the same way everywhere

signatures.name: bleed-grid-line
signatures.what: a grid line that bleeds off the page edge
